query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM reports
        WHERE author_id = $1
          AND ($2::report_status IS NULL OR status = $2)
          AND ($3::text IS NULL OR location_code LIKE $3 || '-%')
          AND (
            $4::text IS NULL
            OR location_code ILIKE '%' || $4 || '%' ESCAPE '\'
            OR EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM unnest(responsible_parties) AS party
              WHERE party ILIKE '%' || $4 || '%' ESCAPE '\'
            )
          )
